parameters.help_en:
The content of the existing CSR file.  
The key type of the CSR file must be RSA or ECC. If the RSA algorithm is used, the key length must be greater than or equal to 2048 bits. For more information about how to create a CSR file, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42218.html.  <props="china">You can also create a CSR in the Certificate Management Service console (https://yundunnext.console.aliyun.com/?&p=cas). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313297.html.  </props>
A CSR is digital certificate signing request file that contains your server and company information. When you apply for digital certificate, you must submit the CSR file to the CA for review. After the CA signs the CSR file with the private key of the root certificate, digital certificate public key file (the SSL certificate issued to you) is generated.

The CN field in the CSR specifies the domain name bound to the certificate
parameters.help_zh:
已有的CSR文件的内容。  
CSR文件的密钥类型必须是RSA、ECC算法，且RSA算法的密钥长度必须大于等于2048。关于CSR文件的制作方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42218.html。  <props="china">您也可以在数字证书管理服务控制台 (https://yundunnext.console.aliyun.com/?&p=cas)创建CSR，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313297.html。  </props>
CSR（Certificate Signing Request）是证书签名请求文件，包含了您的服务器信息和公司信息。申请证书时需要将您证书的CSR文件提交给CA认证中心审核，CA中心对CSR文件进行根证书私钥签名后，会生成证书公钥文件（即签发给您的SSL证书）。

CSR中的CN字段表示证书绑定的域名
parameters.name: csr

parameters.help_en:
The certificate specification for which you want to apply. Valid values:

digicert-free-1-free (default): a 3-month free DV certificate for individual testing. Available only on the China site.
symantec-free-1-free: a 12-month pro DV certificate for individual testing. Available only on the China site.
symantec-dv-1-starter: a DigiCert DV wildcard certificate.

geotrust-dv-1-starter: a GeoTrust DV single-domain certificate.
geotrust-dv-w-starter: a GeoTrust DV wildcard certificate.

globalsign-dv-1-personal: a GlobalSign DV single-domain certificate.
globalsign-dv-w-advanced: a GlobalSign DV wildcard certificate
parameters.help_zh:
要申请的证书规格。取值：

digicert-free-1-free（默认）：表示3个月个人测试证书（免费版）。仅中国站。
symantec-free-1-free：表示12个月的个人测试证书（pro）。仅中国站。
symantec-dv-1-starter：表示DigiCert DV通配符域名证书。

geotrust-dv-1-starter：表示GeoTrust DV单域名证书。
geotrust-dv-w-starter：表示GeoTrust DV通配符域名证书。

globalsign-dv-1-personal：表示GlobalSign DV单域名证书。
globalsign-dv-w-advanced：表示GlobalSign DV通配符域名证书

parameters.help_en:
The validation method for domain name ownership. Valid values:

DNS: DNS validation. You can validate the ownership of the domain name by adding a TXT DNS record for the domain name on the DNS management platform. You must have the management permissions on DNS resolution to complete the validation.
FILE: file validation. You can validate the ownership of the domain name by creating a specified file on the domain name server. You must have the administrator permissions on the domain name server to complete the validation.

For more information about the two validation methods, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48016.html
parameters.help_zh:
域名所有权的验证方式。取值：

DNS：DNS验证。通过在域名的DNS管理平台为域名添加一条TXT类型的DNS记录，验证域名的所有权。您需要域名解析的管理权限，才可以完成验证。
FILE：文件验证。通过在域名服务器上创建指定的文件，验证域名的所有权。您需要域名服务器的管理员权限，才可以完成验证。

关于两种验证方式的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48016.html

OrderId.description_en:
The ID of the certificate application order.

You can use this ID to query the application status of the certificate. For more information, see [DescribeCertificateState]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455800.html）
